scripts.admin:hash-password: node -e "const { randomBytes, scryptSync } = require('node:crypto'); const p = process.argv[1]; if (!p) { console.error('Usage: pnpm admin:hash-password <password>'); process.exit(1); } const s = randomBytes(16).toString('hex'); const h = scryptSync(p, s, 64).toString('hex'); console.log('Hash:'); console.log('scrypt$' + s + '$' + h); console.log(''); console.log('Copy hash di atas ke .env Anda sebagai ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH');"
